technology_name: Coir Pith Carbon Bio-Briquette (PEATKOL Dots) Technology
problem_solved: Environmental pollution from traditional coal and charcoal, and the need for sustainable utilization of coir pith biomass.
description: A process for producing lightweight carbon bio-briquettes, named PEATKOL Dots, by strongly heating coirpith with limited air. The formulation utilizes the lignin in coirpith, which carbonizes to provide strength to the briquettes, creating an alternative fuel resource.
applications: • Manufacturing of eco-friendly commercial grilling and barbecue fuels • Production of natural incense and dhoop burning bases • Processing of agricultural coir pith waste into renewable energy briquettes • Deployment in commercial indoor and outdoor heating applications
secondary_sector: Water, Environment & Waste Management, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
